_comment: VS Code extensions that break this course folder's arrangement, read by
`im update`, which removes any of them it finds and says why.
This list is published with the course folder rather than built into the
im-course-tools package, so a conflict found in class can be added here
and reach every student on their next `im update`, without releasing a
new version of the package to a hundred machines.
Keep it short, and prefer a fix that is not this one. Everything named
here is uninstalled from a student's editor, for all of their projects
and not only this one, and an extension that arrives inside somebody
else's extension pack comes back with the next update of it -- so an
uninstall is a repair that has to keep being made. The list is empty
today for exactly that reason.
ms-python.vscode-python-envs was the first entry and is no longer here.
It contributes a "Run as Task" entry to the Run menu whose `when` clause
does not check the setting that switches the extension off, so a student
who clicked it was told the command was not found. Uninstalling stopped
that until ms-python.python installed it again; munch-group.im-pixi-vscode
now registers the command that entry points at, which the extension
itself leaves unregistered whenever it is switched off, so the button
runs the file on the .pixi interpreter instead of failing. See
src/python/runAsTask.ts in that extension.
`why` is printed to the student under the line saying what was removed,
so write it to be read by someone who did not ask for any of this.
